fields.description: Yas Park Place is Aldar's garden-focused apartment community beside Yas Central Park. Six midrise buildings bring studios, one- to three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes into a setting of landscaped courtyards, resident facilities and planned ground-level shops and dining.

overview: The presentation specifies porcelain flooring, laminate joinery and engineered-stone worktops, with light and dark interior options. These are material references rather than a promise about a particular unit's final finish. The duplex drawing separates lower living space from upper bedrooms; maid rooms are identified separately from bedrooms.
research.locationNote: Aldar places the development beside Yas Central Park, with access to the Yas Acres road network and the E11. The launch describes a walkable ground-level retail promenade. Routes, outlooks and delivery of neighbouring services should be checked for the chosen building.
research.priceNote: The original studio guide is AED 1.39m. The presentation also gives AED 1.90m for one bedroom, AED 2.95m for two bedrooms and AED 5m for three bedrooms with maid room. These historical references do not establish present availability; obtain a dated unit offer.
research.paymentNote: The launch structure is 50/50, with 5% at booking. The remaining 45% is paid during construction and 50% at handover. The table deliberately groups construction instalments because a dated developer-issued calendar was not established; exact dates depend on the purchase agreement.
research.handoverNote: The branded fact sheet estimates Q1 2030. Confirm the selected building's contractual programme rather than treating a portal's January date as a guaranteed handover day.

paymentStages.stage: During construction · dated schedule to confirm

facts.label: Announced release mix
facts.value: 780 homes: 180 studios, 384 one-bedroom, 143 two-bedroom, nine two-bedroom duplexes and 64 three-bedroom apartments. Counts describe the launch mix, not current stock.

facts.label: Parking reference
facts.value: The presentation allocates one space to studios and conventional one/two-bedroom apartments, and two to duplexes and three-bedroom homes. Confirm the unit's contractual allocation.

facts.label: Published service-charge reference
facts.value: The presentation quotes AED 23.45 per sq ft. Confirm the approved annual budget, chargeable area and inclusions before budgeting.

facts.label: Environmental target
facts.value: Aldar's launch targets Estidama Pearl 3. This describes a target, not an independently verified completed-building certification.

unresolved: Confirm current availability, building and unit allocation, registered area and balcony treatment; averages do not define every apartment.
Exact dated instalments, completion arrangements and service-charge approvals require developer documentation.
The presentation describes limited launch-week incentives. Their expiry and eligibility were not verified, so they are not offered as current benefits.
Some portals list one building, townhouses or inconsistent areas; the six-building announcement and own apartment documents take precedence. Photography remains illustrative.
